crossRefs.note: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.
and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven…
Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less…

translations.web: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
translations.bsb: A great number of people followed Him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him.
translations.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
translations.asv: And there followed him a great multitude of the people, and of women who bewailed and lamented him.
